title: Slovakian Gruyere Dumplings
description: A hearty Slovakian dish featuring fluffy dumplings and melted Gruyere cheese. Serve as a main course.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour and salt.
Gradually add warm water and mix until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a ball and then flatten slightly into a disk shape.
In a large pot of boiling water, cook the dumplings for 10-12 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Meanwhile, melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add sliced sausage and cook until browned.
Add chopped onion and grated carrot and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in shredded Gruyere cheese until melted.
Serve the dumplings with the sausage and vegetable mixture.
Season with black pepper to taste.
